map.体积不变时，理想气体压强与热力学温度成正比。: At constant volume, ideal-gas pressure is proportional to thermodynamic temperature.
map.P₁/T₁ = P₂/T₂，温度须为开尔文。: P1/T1 = P2/T2; temperature must be in kelvin.
map.密闭容器升温压强估算。: Estimate pressure rise in a sealed container when heated.
map.盖-吕萨克是定容 P∝T，查理是定压 V∝T。: Gay-Lussac is constant-volume P~T, Charles is constant-pressure V~T.
map.密闭容器升温压强线性上升，须校核承压。: A sealed container sees pressure rise linearly with heating and must be checked for pressure rating.
map.盖-吕萨克定律（等容过程）：P₂ = P₁·T₂ ÷ T₁（kPa，T 取开尔文: Gay-Lussac's law (isochoric process): P₂ = P₁·T₂ ÷ T₁ (kPa, T in kelvin); linked values: pressure magnification = P₂ ÷ P₁, pressure increment ΔP = P₂ − P₁ (kPa). Validation: non-empty guards for P₁, T₁ and T₂; setting P₁ or T₁ to 0 reports “the denominator cannot be 0”, and all-zero input errors out. Criteria: no fixed grading; at constant volume pressure is proportional to thermodynamic temperature.
